query:
SELECT
            p.id,
            p.kind AS "kind: ProductKind",
            p.sku,
            p.name,
            p.description,
            p.price,
            p.min_stock,
            p.is_active,
            p.created_at,
            p.updated_at,
            s.stock
        FROM products p
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE m.reason
                    WHEN 'purchase'   THEN m.quantity
                    WHEN 'adjustment' THEN m.quantity
                    WHEN 'sale'       THEN -m.quantity
                    WHEN 'loss'       THEN -m.quantity
                END
            ), 0) AS stock
            FROM stock_movements m
            WHERE m.product_id = p.id
        ) s ON true
        WHERE p.id = $1
